notes.title: Full Release!
notes.content:
[h1][b]I have decided to fully release the game! [/b][/h1]

I want to focus my efforts on a much bigger and more immersive game,[b] but don't worry[/b] I am still going to apply updates to this game too. More so just fixes to bugs or problems, or the occasional something new.

[b]Because of this, I have decreased the price down to $2.99 USD. [/b]]

Thank you for playing.

notes.title: Update 1.3.2 Now Live!!
notes.content:
[b][h1]NOTES[/h1][/b]

Added [b]Bots Team Deathmatch[/b] (You and ai Team VS Another).

Added New Zombie run animations, blended the attack animations better with the run animations.

Added [b]New Zombies Map!![/b] (Called Eastern Village).

New Map Has Buyable Weapons Through out the map.

Fixed where zombies would stop going after the player because player was unreachable, or on top of the mystery crate.

Updated The main Menu and pause menu.

Removed Night mode and player flashlight (For Now).

Adjusted AI Navigation to help improve on the AI movements.

Feel free to leave feedback.

notes.title: Working On A BIG Update!
notes.content:
[h2][b]WORKING ON A BIG! UPDATE[/b][/h2]


Some things to look forward to...

Bots Mode! (You and your AI team VS Another AI Team) NOT MULTIPLAYER THOUGH..

NEW map dedicated to zombies (Called Eastern Village) Old map will be just for The Bots TDM mode.

Updated Zombie Animations, and AI can parkour now, so no escaping them by getting on top of stuff.

Updated the menu system.

Thinking about changing the name of the game to "Amongst The Dead" 
[h1]
And possibly more, whatever else I can squeeze in!![/h1]

notes.title: Update Notes For February 11th
notes.content:
[h1][b]Changes/Improvements[/b][/h1]

Added Health pickups around the map. Regenerates 25 Health and takes 3 Minutes to respawn.

Reduced cost of the mystery crate by 1000. It's now 2500 to open, and 1500 to reroll.

Renamed Some weapon Presets.

Increased Skylight Brightness On The Main Map, and Decreased Sunlight Brightness.

Slightly Increased Zombie Attack Range.

Adjusted AI Navigation, In attempt to make zombie movements more smooth/Natural.

Added New Zombie Attack Animation.

notes.title: Update Notes For February 7th
notes.content:
[h1][b]Fixes/Changes[/b][/h1]

Adjusted lighting on the Main Map.

Reduced time that it takes for the dead zombies to vanish.

Adjusted Navigation, To reduce Zombies Getting Slowed down while passing through narrow spaces.

Reduced The amount that a zombies health increases by wave.

Added 3 additional Crate Spawn Locations!

Added outdoor lighting, to increase visibility during night time.

Decreased Zombies footstep volume.
